iOS 27 brings a range of new Home Screen widgets across various apps, and the Apple Calendar widget has become my personal favourite. Here's a detailed introduction for everyone.

iOS 27 adds two extra-large widgets for Calendar, and "List View" has become my new favourite

In anticipation of the upcoming iPhone Ultra and its extra-large display, iOS 27 introduces a new widget size that pairs perfectly with the device.

iOS 27 offers extra-large widgets for multiple Apple apps, delivering rich value no matter which iPhone you use.

The larger widget size lets you see more information at a glance. For example, the Home app widget can control more smart home accessories; Notes can display more notes simultaneously, and more.

Among this batch of widgets, my favourite is the Apple Calendar widget.

iOS 27 adds two extra-large widgets to Calendar in one go:

  • List View: See your upcoming events in a compact layout at a glance.
  • Next Up: Stay on top of your upcoming events and meetings.

Depending on how packed your calendar is, you may prefer one over the other. But for me, the "List View" widget fits my needs perfectly.

The extra-large Calendar widget takes up space equivalent to 4×6 app icons — roughly a full Home Screen page. But if you don't want to dedicate a full Home Screen page to it, placing it in the Today View is also a great option.

Whether I place a widget on the Home Screen or in Today View, I can see upcoming events covering most of the next week (with the option to include Reminders).

I love being able to glance at my schedule for the next few days at a glance without manually opening the Calendar app. This new widget delivers exactly that.

Will you use the new extra-large Calendar widgets in iOS 27? Which other new widgets are your favourites? Share with us in the comments section.
